title: GLM 5.2 本地部署长上下文实测(~100k)
author: myanvoos
cached_full_text: my inability to get 2 more @NVIDIAAI DGX Sparks have led to a truly cursed custom fork of ik-llama-cpp, so that I now have a custom ~3.6 bpw quant of @0xSero's GLM 5.2 REAP running at 13 decode tok/s with very usable long-context prefill (via DSA) and ~100k context window on just [本地硬件]. 本地部署可跑约100k上下文。
